<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.CurvaturesBivariate: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Calculates the profile and planar curvatures, the slope and the aspect of the terrain from a quadratic surface fitted by least squares to a window of pCells x pCells cells around each cell. Larger windows describe the forms at a larger scale. The cells closer to the border of the map or of the no-data than half the window are left as no-data.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Geomorphology, Curvature, Bivariate, Slope, Aspect, Multiscale<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.CurvaturesBivariate`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file | m |  | The map of the elevation. |
| `pCells` | int | cells | `3` | The size of the window, in cells: an odd number, at least 3. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outProf` | output file | 1/m | The map of the profile curvature, along the steepest slope: positive where the slope decreases downhill (concave), negative where it increases (convex). |
| `outPlan` | output file | 1/m | The map of the planar curvature, of the contour lines: positive where the flow converges, as in the valleys, negative where it diverges, as on the ridges. |
| `outSlope` | output file | degree | The map of the slope, in degrees. |
| `outAspect` | output file | degree | The map of the aspect, in degrees clockwise from north: 0 for the slopes facing north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west. No-data on the flat cells. |

**References**

- Wood, J. (1996). The geomorphological characterisation of digital elevation models. PhD thesis, University of Leicester.
- Wilson, M. F. J., O'Connell, B., Brown, C., Guinan, J. C., Grehan, A. J. (2007). Multiscale terrain analysis of multibeam bathymetry data for habitat mapping on the continental slope. Marine Geodesy, 30(1-2), 3-35.
